docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
A course in French for English speakers: the sounds of French, nouns, articles and adjectives, verbs and their tenses, pronouns, sentence structure, vocabulary by topic, and lessons for beginners and intermediate learners.

From Wikibooks · CC BY-SA 4.0

French, a Wikibooks textbook, by its contributors. This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from Wikibooks when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution. Licence: CC BY-SA 4.0. Modified: converted to this format.
